import json, os, re, urllib.request
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    p = json.loads(raw); raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
mask = lambda s: re.sub(r"\d{5,}", lambda m: "***" + m.group(0)[-4:], str(s))
for cid in ("b8b4add0-5ef6-4887-9e35-59a028aa96c9", "8a124841-e9d4-4e7c-8594-7599c79b6b05", "b5920ad5-21f2-455c-b1f5-4be6959fb938"):
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai/v1/sms/conversations/" + cid, headers={"Authorization": raw, "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        d = json.loads(r.read().decode())
    d = d.get("data") if isinstance(d.get("data"), dict) else d
    print("CONV ...%s node=%s user=%s" % (cid[-6:], d.get("current_node_id"), mask(d.get("user_number"))))
    for m in d.get("messages") or []:
        if isinstance(m, dict):
            print("  [%s] %s status=%s err=%s len=%d" % (str(m.get("created_at", ""))[:19], m.get("sender", "?"), m.get("status", "?"), m.get("error_code"), len(str(m.get("message", "")))))
print("DELIVERY_DONE")
PY
rc=$?
